name: ReflectiveCard-TS-TW

frames.best_why: A broad metallic sheen covers the card and the name reads most clearly against it.

tagline: A portrait card of frosted silver metal, mirrored live from the camera.
summary: A tall frosted-metal ID card that mirrors whatever the webcam sees behind a blurred, grainy silver surface. White text shows a name and job title, a secure-access badge, an ID number and a fingerprint mark.
appearance: A tall rounded card filled by a light grey, grainy, blurred metal surface with a bright glow drifting across the middle. White uppercase text sits over it: a small badge and activity icon at the top, the name ALEXANDER DOE with SENIOR DEVELOPER beneath, and an ID number above a fingerprint icon.
behaviour: The surface reflects the live camera feed through a blurred, monochrome, metallic filter, so the sheen and grain shift as the scene in front of the camera moves. The overlay text and badge stay fixed.
demo_content: Name ALEXANDER DOE, title SENIOR DEVELOPER, badge SECURE ACCESS and ID number 8901-2345-6789.
search_phrases: card that mirrors your webcam like metal
live camera reflection on a card
use_when: You want a login or profile card that shows a live, stylised camera view of the user as a security pass.
avoid_when: It needs camera permission; without a working webcam the surface stays blank grey and the white text is low contrast.
customise: Props tune blur strength, text colour, metalness, roughness, overlay colour, displacement, noise scale, specular, grayscale and distortion. The name, title, badge and ID text are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A live video stream runs an SVG turbulence and displacement filter on every frame.

a11y.note: It requests the camera on mount with no visible fallback, and white text over a bright live surface is very low contrast.

issues: The catalogue says the glare tracks the cursor, but the code has no pointer handlers; only the webcam changes.
The white name, badge and ID text sit on a bright surface with very low contrast.
Camera permission is requested on load with no visible fallback when it is denied.
polish_why: Distinctive metallic surface, but the washed-out reflection buries the text and detail.
